items.title: 6.5.1 Tracking the Origin of Products (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of product tracking (PDF 165-166).

blocks.text: Blockchain supply chain ki har hawalgi decentralized ledger par darj karta hai, to kachche maal ke supplier se aakhri gahak tak har qadam ka suragh mumkin aur na-qabil-e-tabdeel hai. Chocolate jaise product ke liye supplier se manufacturer, fabricator, intermediary, retailer aur customer tak jane par records jurte hain, aur gahak tareekh dekh kar maakhaz aur maeyar ki tasdeeq kar sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: supplier, manufacturer, fabricator, intermediary, retailer aur customer ki supply chain, har hawalgi mushtarak ledger ki line par record se juri. Neeche baen: plain text key ke saath encryption se cipher text aur key ke saath decryption se wapas, band khat ki misal ke saath. Neeche daen: edge computing, serverless, Blockchain 2.0, AI aur blockchain, IoT aur blockchain ek ek line ke notes ke saath.
blocks.caption: Product tracking, encryption aur mustaqbil ke rujhanat (topics 6.5 aur 6.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Chocolate jaisa product supplier se manufacturer, fabricator, intermediary, retailer aur customer tak jata hai, aur har hawalgi mushtarak ledger par darj hoti hai, to customer product ka asal maakhaz dekh sakta hai. Encryption key se parhne ke qabil plain text ko cipher text banati hai, aur durust key se decryption use wapas badalti hai; digital signatures, record rakhne wale network aur kai copies ke saath yeh blockchain data ko parhna, jaali banana ya badalna mushkil rakhti hai. Mustaqbil ke rujhanat mein data ke qareeb edge computing, serverless computing, smart contracts aur decentralized apps wala Blockchain 2.0, aur AI aur IoT ke saath blockchain shamil hain.

blocks.prompt: Blockchain ko IoT se jorna supply chain management kaise behtar karta hai (short question 6)?
blocks.explanation: IoT sensors har marhale par jagah, darja-e-hararat aur waqt jaisa data khud darj karte hain, aur un readings ko blockchain par likhna unhein chhed-chhaar se mehfooz aur chain mein sab ke liye wazeh banata hai. Khareedar bharosa kar sakte hain ke maal kahan aur kaise gaya, masail ka maakhaz dhoonda ja sakta hai, aur dhoka aur ghaltiyan kam hoti hain.

items: Product tracking: har hawalgi ledger par; gahak maakhaz ki tasdeeq kar sakta hai (chocolate ki misal).
